description: `a` alone has depth exactly 16 (allowed by Core on its own — see §9). `a.k`, one level in, has depth 15. Copying it three wrapping levels deep under `wrapper` pushes the total to 18, exceeding the limit only once the reference is inserted — Core's own pre-resolution check on `a` never fires. References §5/R-112: the error is attributed to the `($a.k)` token's own line and includes the token text, not the line-1 fallback (R-113 applies only when no reference token can be identified as a participant, which does not hold here).
